name: Jhonatan Moreno Velásquez
headline: Senior Full Stack Developer · on the path to Tech Lead
bio: I'm a Senior Full Stack Developer with 6+ years of experience designing, developing and maintaining scalable web applications and cloud-native solutions. My focus is the backend with Node.js, NestJS, Laravel, AWS and microservices. I build serverless solutions with Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway and DynamoDB, with infrastructure as code in Terraform. On the frontend I work with Angular, React and React Native, and I apply Scrum, CI/CD and good practices for performance, scalability and security.
